timeline.draft_answer: Research on pseudocereals (buckwheat, quinoa, and amaranth) is being conducted at ETH Zurich's World Food System Center (WFSC). A research project supported by Coop at the WFSC examined buckwheat cultivation and identified the most suitable buckwheat varieties for Switzerland. Researchers there have examined existing diversity, carried out taste tests, and begun describing the genomic diversity of buckwheat. The chunks do not name the individual scientists involved.
